name: web-interest-circles-picker-carousel-of-photo-tiles
title: Interest Picker Carousel of Photo Tiles
whatItIs: A pale desktop screen with a centred prompt asking users to choose five interests, a horizontal row of rounded photo tiles fading at the edges with one highlighted red tile, and a tray below holding selected choices and a disabled Next button.
whatItMeans: Big image tiles make choosing feel like browsing, and edge fades suggest a long list.
techniques: Row of photo tiles fading at both edges
Enlarged highlighted tile under the cursor
Selection tray with empty slots and counter

vocabulary.definition: A selection UI built from image tiles.
Items fading out at the edges of a scroll row.
A panel showing the items chosen so far.
